slides.title: 6 things to decide before your wardrobe is made
Hinged or sliding?
slides.body: Sliding needs less room in front. Hinged gives full access to every section.

slides.title: Long vs short hanging
slides.body: Count your sarees, suits and coats. Then split the hanging height.

slides.title: Use the loft
slides.body: Top lofts hold suitcases and quilts. Plan them with the wardrobe, not later.

slides.title: Drawers inside
slides.body: Internal drawers keep small items dust-free and look cleaner than open shelves.

slides.fact: A mirror on one shutter reflects light and makes the room feel bigger.

slides.title: Board and edges
slides.body: MR ply for dry rooms is fine. Insist on machine-pressed edge banding.
